scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir frontend run build:cloudflare
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --dir frontend exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config ../wrangler.jsonc

DB.description: Stores boards, folders, shares, and video metadata. Tables are created automatically during deployment.

BUCKET.description: Stores drawing scenes, recovery revisions, and uploaded videos.

ALLOW_DEMO_AUTH.description: Set to true to enable the shared, publicly editable demo workspace linked from Try demo. Personal boards always require sign-in. Set to false to disable the demo.

NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Your Clerk application's **Publishable key** (pk_test_… or pk_live_…) from [Clerk API keys](https://dashboard.clerk.com/last-active?path=api-keys). Use the matching secret key below.

CLERK_SECRET_KEY.description: Your Clerk application's **Secret key** (sk_test_… or sk_live_…). Stored as an encrypted Worker secret.
